sections: The Part II overhaul moves character progression toward equipment slots rather than individual equipment pieces. This is an unofficial English summary of the Korean developer notice.
Four new equipment types are introduced: Bracer, Belt, Artifact and Seal. Accessories become part of the main equipment progression system.

Existing equipment converts automatically. Some high-end pieces receive additional item levels. The examples apply to individual weapons and armor pieces, not the character average. Sidereal weapons have separate rules.

Quality compensation is based on the highest eligible quality equipment owned for each weapon and armor slot. Sidereal weapons are excluded from standard quality compensation. Existing Artisan’s Energy carries over to its corresponding slot. Exact exchange rates remain unverified.
Sidereal weapons have separate item-level conversion and material refund rules. Refunded materials are described as character-bound. Selected examples only.

Qualifying accessories receive Magic Infusion Scrolls in six grades; existing trade limits are preserved. H, M and L mean high, medium and low effect rolls. Only the best qualifying bracelet per character produces a Seal Infusion Scroll (grades 1–21). Remaining bracelets become dismantling materials; T3 bracelets are deleted. Qualifying Relic support necklaces and rings with H/H were summarized as grade 5. Exact eligibility needs verification.

Ability stones are removed and replaced with engraving-slot upgrades. Relic becomes the base engraving rarity. The conversion uses effective activation points, not raw faceting numbers. Both positive engravings must qualify for the character’s permitted DPS or support combinations. Negative effects do not affect conversion. A 4+4 stone also grants extra items.

Tradable gems become roster-shared, with simultaneous use by multiple characters. Character-bound gems remain restricted. A new higher-tier gem, provisionally called Celestial Gem, is introduced above T4 level 10. Three T4 level 10 gems make the first Celestial gem, then two same-level gems make the next level. Maximum level is not specified. Important exception: qualifying T4 level 8 Gems of Brilliance obtained through previous paid growth events/products or Paradise content are converted into a selection box instead of the standard same-level conversion. Choose one new non-tradable T4 level 8 gem or one new tradable T4 level 7 gem. Choosing the tradable level 7 option allows you to trade it or use it for gem fusion. This exception applies only to gems from the specified acquisition routes, not every level 8 gem.

Proficiency increases damage and allied attack-power buffs. Combat stats become freely assignable through Ark Passive, which unlocks at combat level 50. Cards no longer need to be manually equipped; similar effects do not stack and the strongest applies.
After all six designated characters have earned their weekly gold rewards, additional characters can earn character-bound gold from endgame content.

Life skills, sailing, stronghold, pets, and the player economy are being simplified. Direct player-to-player item trading uses a trust system, with additional Pheon fees possible for insufficient trust.
12. What to do before Part II launches

These eight preparation actions are carried over from the earlier English summary. Verify each against the official notice before spending materials or making irreversible decisions. Checklist progress is stored on your own device.
Interpretation, not an official promise. The overall direction appears to be consolidating character power into slots and reducing the cost and complexity of maintaining alts.

balance.description: Latest major Korean live-server class balance update located as of 25 November. Selected changes in English, not a complete skill-by-skill translation. Western implementation and timing are not confirmed. The original notice could not be retrieved directly; the summary uses Korean reposts and reporting.
